text:
Artturi Lehkonen has 16 goals in 24 games, and the timing matters: his contract runs out after this season, and The Hockey News has already asked whether the Avalanche can afford to keep him, or afford to lose him. He's playing nearly 19 minutes a night and getting to the right places. His 10.16 expected goals (the quality of his chances) is a strong number by itself, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking last season had him 90th percentile for chances from in front of the net.

The finishing is the part to discount. He's shooting 31%, against 14% last season, and Colorado has scored 14 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice. Evolving-Hockey also notes he plays with very strong teammates. His last ten games, four goals and six points, already look more normal. Our numbers project 37 goals. For the Avalanche, the contract question is what his chances are worth, not his shooting percentage.
headline: Artturi Lehkonen's goal pace is real chances, unreal finishing
